snippet.title: Frosthaven 1.0 Launch Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Entering 1.0 today Frosthaven is the digital adaptation of Isaac Childres' hit board game, a tactical card-driven campaign set around a frozen northern outpost. You pick your mercenaries, plan every move with your hand of cards, and survive brutal scenarios solo or in co-op.
